title: Mystical Additions
description: Small primarily cosmetic and decorative additions for me and my friends!
body:
# Mystical Additions
A small mod primarily meant for me and my friends. Adds decorative plushies, and a gachapon mechanic to acquire them. This mod also includes some other small features, which will be elaborated on in the subsequent section.
## Current Additions & Features
* A unique gachapon mechanic in which players can find Mystical Boxes within pre-existing chests, and use them to acquire plushies
* Three unique plushies:
  * The Classic Mysmay Plushy
  * The Maskless Mysmay Plushy
  * The Vibrant Mysmay Plushy
* Mysmay's Mask — a cosmetic item acquirable from the Classic Mysmay Plushy by right-clicking it with shears
* Plushy Essence — an item craftable from duplicate plushies, which can then be crafted into additional Mystical Boxes
* The Display Box — a craftable box that can be used to display your plushies
* The Best Sandwich Ever — a food item that is rarely, _very rarely_ dropped from witches (this is an inside joke that I don't think anyone will ever understand)
